description: Make the GitHub PR check gate synchronize an AI-approved candidate before verification and require non-empty passing PR checks.

tasks.title: Synchronize the approved PR candidate in the check gate
tasks.description: Update the built-in mohist/github-pr workflow so a passing AI review is followed by the existing rebase action before push, PR readying, and PR-check verification. Reuse integrate's conflict-resolution handler without retrying a resolved rebase, keep review-failure recovery unsynchronized, and preserve integrate's existing final merge protection.
acceptanceCriteria: The check-stage task order after successful AI review is rebase onto repository.baseBranch, push, mark the existing PR ready, then verify PR checks before approval can be requested.

The post-review rebase uses origin, does not squash, and on a conflict invokes the existing rebase-conflict resolution prompt without retrying the rebase or starting check verification before resolution completes.
The review-failure repair and re-review path contains no base-synchronization step, while an already-current branch can complete the configured rebase without an extra workflow branch.

Profile specification tests assert the rebase placement, conflict recovery configuration, check-stage ordering, and unchanged integrate base-moved and branch-protection recovery; the server test suite passes.
tasks.output: Updated built-in GitHub PR workflow definition and workflow-profile specification coverage.
tasks.notes: Do not add workflow variables, a mergeable preflight, or a new action.

tasks.title: Reject unavailable GitHub PR checks after bounded polling
tasks.description: Change mohist/github-pr-checks polling so an empty status-check rollup continues through the existing bounded wait and then returns unavailable rather than passing. Preserve the existing action contract and actionable pr-checks-unavailable error mapping; only non-empty, completed, non-failing rollups may pass.
acceptanceCriteria: An initially empty PR check rollup is polled for the existing bounded grace period and succeeds only if a non-empty passing rollup appears before the deadline.
A rollup that remains empty through the deadline returns unavailable and is surfaced as pr-checks-unavailable rather than as a successful result or a speculative repair loop.
Non-empty rollups with pending or failed checks do not pass, while a non-empty rollup with every check completed and non-failing passes.
Runner unit tests cover empty-to-passing, permanently empty, pending, failed, and passing rollups using injected timing and fake gh responses; runner typecheck and tests pass.
tasks.output: Updated GitHub PR checks polling/classification implementation and runner unit coverage.
tasks.notes: Keep the current Action inputs and schemas unchanged.
